title: South-Up Basis and Viewpoint-Safe Handedness
objective: Implement the locked South-Up orientation without north/south or viewpoint sign confusion.
negative_results: A rotation applied without a declared viewpoint is refused (refuse_rotation_without_viewpoint): a bare 'clockwise' is ambiguous.
The SAME physical rotation is clockwise from the Antarctic external viewpoint and anticlockwise from North-down; equivalent descriptions round-trip to the identical matrix.
Orientation is a declared operator convention realized as rotation arithmetic (DERIVED_MATHEMATICS); it validates nothing physical.

claims.statement: Viewpoint is a mandatory part of every rotation, so the handedness sign is never ambiguous across the two locked viewpoints.

privacy_check: CLEAN - pure rotation arithmetic; no private reads, no personal names or paths.
